limitations: The Rialto venue settlement was SIMULATED (dev-only mock at the registry-resolved target); the real venue quote format, settlement selector, and eligibility controls remain unverified (known config blocker).
Snapshot weights were computed in-test from positionWeightAt over known participants; production needs event-indexed wallet enumeration (indexer not implemented).
allocationsContentHash/manifestEnvelopeHash were rehearsal placeholders (keccak of fixed strings), not TS-pipeline artifacts.
Participant WETH balances were synthesized fork-locally (storage writes).
The claim window used a short rehearsal window (start +60s, deadline +3600s), not the 90-day production policy value.

negativeCoverageMap.note: One-to-one mapping of every required negative/boundary condition (TASK 10F-1 section 7) to the exact fork-test assertion or the named existing unit test. No condition is left as a vague reference. No required implemented control is UNPROVEN.
negativeCoverageMap.invalidMerkleProof: FORK ForkDistributionLifecycle.testForkDistributionLifecycle stage12 expectRevert(InvalidProof) [wrong-claimant + wrong-amount variants]; UNIT RialtoEndToEnd.testInvalidProofCannotClaim
negativeCoverageMap.wrongClaimant: FORK ForkDistributionLifecycle.testForkDistributionLifecycle stage12 expectRevert(InvalidProof) — BOB submits ALICE's valid proof
negativeCoverageMap.wrongAmount: FORK ForkDistributionLifecycle.testForkDistributionLifecycle stage12 expectRevert(InvalidProof) — BOB claims eB+1 under his own proof
negativeCoverageMap.replayAttempt: FORK ForkDistributionLifecycle.testForkDistributionLifecycle stage12 — identical claim calldata resubmitted, rejected by the claimed-flag (same AlreadyClaimed assertion; effects-before-interaction)
negativeCoverageMap.claimWrongRootOrEpoch: FORK ForkDistributionLifecycle.testForkDistributionLifecycle stage12 expectRevert(CycleNotFound(CYCLE_ID+1)) — claim against a non-existent cycle/epoch
negativeCoverageMap.claimBeforeRootPublication: FORK ForkDistributionLifecycle.testForkDistributionLifecycle stage10 expectRevert(CycleNotFound) pre-publication AND stage11 expectRevert(ClaimNotStarted) post-publication/pre-start
negativeCoverageMap.adapterUnderDelivery: FORK ForkDistributionLifecycle.testForkDistributionLifecycle stage8 expectRevert(MinimumStockOutNotMet(expectStock+1, expectStock)); UNIT RialtoAdapterHostile.testUnderDeliver + StockVaultHostile.testUnderMinReverts
negativeCoverageMap.adapterOverDeliveryOrUnexpectedAsset: INAPPLICABLE on-fork for honest over-delivery: frozen vault semantics credit the full observed delta (no cap above minStockOut) and the fixed-rate mock venue cannot over-deliver; hostile variants UNIT-covered: RialtoAdapterHostile.testWrongTokenDelivery/.testOutputToAttacker/.testExcessPull + StockVaultHostile.testLieOverReverts/.testWrongTokenDeliveryReverts/.testRetainStockReverts
negativeCoverageMap.failedAcquisitionNoSilentLoss: FORK ForkDistributionLifecycle.testForkDistributionLifecycle stage8 post-revert asserts: availableWethCustody unchanged + acquisitionCount==0 (atomic rollback); UNIT RialtoEndToEnd.testHostileRialtoRollsBackAcquisition
negativeCoverageMap.zeroValueOrDustBoundary: FORK ForkDistributionLifecycle.testForkDistributionLifecycle stages 12-14: dust==3 units tracked exactly through claims, remaining, outstanding, and recovery to zero residue; zero-budget trade minimums UNIT-covered: RouterBuy.testZeroBurnBudgetSkipsSwap/.testZeroBurnBudgetNonzeroMinFails + RouterSell.testZeroBudgetSell/.testZeroBurnBudgetNonzeroMinFails
negativeCoverageMap.feeTotalConservation: FORK ForkDistributionLifecycle.testForkDistributionLifecycle stage2/stage4 exact 2%/1% and 2%/2% splits + stage5 assertion 'fees: vault accrual == sum of 2% stock budgets'
negativeCoverageMap.reserveBalanceConservation: FORK ForkDistributionLifecycle.testForkDistributionLifecycle stage9 'split: reserve delivered to reserveRecipient' (exact) + stage13 global conservation 'acquired == reserve + claims + dust'
negativeCoverageMap.snapshotTotalVsClaimableTotal: FORK ForkDistributionLifecycle.testForkDistributionLifecycle stage10 'snapshot total <= distributable' + stage13 'remaining == dust exactly' / 'outstanding == dust'
negativeCoverageMap.lockEffectiveWeightBoundary: FORK ForkDistributionLifecycle.testForkDistributionLifecycle stage7 exact multiplier assertions for 7d/14d/21d + the live tester lock (x1.10 at snapshot ts); UNIT LockingVaultWeight.testWeightBoundariesUnwithdrawn/.testCanonicalWeights/.testFractionalMultiplierFloorsOnce (incl. 30d tier)
negativeCoverageMap.incorrectChainOrForkSafetyAssertion: FORK ForkDistributionLifecycle.testForkDistributionLifecycle _assertForkLocal() (activeFork + chainid==4663) invoked before EVERY mutating stage + stage0 pinned block/chainid/state-anchor assertions
negativeCoverageMap.expiredDeadline: FORK ForkDistributionLifecycle.testForkDistributionLifecycle stage1 expectRevert(ExpiredDeadline) [trade] + stage8 expectRevert(ExpiredQuote) [settlement quote]

retainedProbeJustification: test/ForkLifecycleProbe.t.sol is intentionally RETAINED (not an abandoned diagnostic): it independently re-validates the two empirical assumptions the lifecycle test depends on — the NVDA Robinhood Token balance mapping location (OZ ERC-7201 namespaced ERC20 slot) and fork-local transferability. If a future NVDA implementation upgrade changes storage layout or transfer gating, the probe fails first with a precise diagnosis. Skip-gated on ROBINHOOD_FORK_RPC; fork-only.
